figures.shows: The robot of the Third-Person sample from the side, from one follow camera: walking at fixed step 39, and seven fixed steps after Run is pressed, about halfway through its 0.2 second cross-fade from walking to running
figures.caption: At fixed step 39 the robot walks, arms low, both feet down. Seven steps after Run is pressed, both clips weigh about one half: the arms swing wide and the feet leave the grass. The run began at its first frame, so the pose mixes unrelated moments of two cycles.
figures.alt: The robot from the side, facing left: walking with arms low and both feet down, then with arms swung wide and its shadow apart from its feet.
figures.numbers: From the recipe and the sample at the pin: the walk side is fixed step 39, before any press; Run is pressed at fixed step 40 and the halfway side is step 47 (fixed steps of 1/60 second, the scene default); the Walk to Run transition of Samples/ThirdPerson/Assets/Animations/Robot.stanimator lasts 0.2 seconds (12 steps). The robot's speed reaches the threshold of 4.5 one or two steps after the press, so 5 to 7 of the 12 steps have run: a progress of 0.42 to 0.58. The camera: FollowCamera Yaw -120, Distance 4.6, PivotHeight 1.0, Pitch -6, field of view 40 degrees; Move held at (-0.866, -0.5), so the robot heads along -Z at 120 degrees to the view.
